description: AICTIONBOT™ supplier segmentation by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T12 (supplier segmentation). Takes the user's supplier list or spend export (one row per supplier or per booking; rows of the same supplier are added up) and places every supplier in one of four fields by business impact and supply risk on a 1 to 5 scale: strategic (partnership at management level), leverage (use competition, tender, consolidate), bottleneck (secure supply, develop alternatives) and transactional (catalogue, framework agreement, automation). Impact can be given or is derived from spend (Pareto 80 percent, a share of 10 percent or more counts as very high); risk can be given or is derived from single source, critical part, number of alternatives and lead time. Returns count, spend and share per field, the largest suppliers per field, strategic or bottleneck suppliers without an alternative and the tail below 1 percent of spend. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

suppliers.description: Rows: supplier, category, spend, impact (1 to 5), risk (1 to 5); instead of risk: single_source (yes/no), critical (yes/no), alternatives (count), lead_time_weeks.

threshold.description: Score from which impact and risk count as high. Default 3.
